mentions.name: Toy Harness
mentions.description: A self-built "Toy Harness" agent harness that the author is creating from scratch to learn how agentic coding tools and tool-using agents work, deliberately without relying on an agent to write the harness itself.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am trying to better my understanding of Agentic coding tools and Tool using Agents by building my own, without relying on an Agent that writes said Agent/Harness

I believe writing my own "Toy Harness" is a good way to learn and understand these tools.
